# The Coding Company (TCC)
> Learn AI. Get Certified. Get Placed.

The Coding Company (TCC) is a global AI community that offers in-depth AI courses, 1,048 role-based AI certifications (TCC CERT+), internships, and a placement program with a published goal of 10,000 offer letters per year.

Key numbers: 1,048 role-based AI certifications · 262 job roles · 32 industries · four tiers (Foundation, Practitioner, Strategist, Executive) · placement goal of 10,000 offer letters per year.

## Machine-readable facts
- [ai.txt](https://thecodingcompany.io/ai.txt) — crawler policy + full fact sheet
- [llms-full.txt](https://thecodingcompany.io/llms-full.txt) — complete overview and every Q&A
- [llms.json](https://thecodingcompany.io/llms.json) — structured entity + Q&A payload
- [faq.jsonl](https://thecodingcompany.io/faq.jsonl) — one question per line
- [sitemap.xml](https://thecodingcompany.io/sitemap.xml) — full sitemap

## TCC CERT+ overview
1,048 credentials = 262 validated job roles × 4 tiers, across 32 industries.
Each credential page documents: description, jobs, hiring companies, and India (₹ LPA) + USD
salary packages (illustrative sample data). Credentials are verifiable and valid for 3 years.

## Prep+ (interview & placement preparation)
- [Prep+ home](https://thecodingcompany.io/prep+/) — practice library.

- [Programming](https://thecodingcompany.io/prep+/programming/) — 5 languages with drills.

- [Company papers](https://thecodingcompany.io/prep+/companies/) — 10 employers, each with year-wise timed practice papers.
- [Mock tests](https://thecodingcompany.io/prep+/mock-tests/) — 4 timed, auto-scored papers.
